accepted_and_rejected_claims.claim: This demonstration links manually verified coaching instructions to observable movement responses in three selected examples. Automated full-session player assessment remains withheld.

RED_01 reduced separation from the manually verified opponents in both pressing events. The event summaries use approximate closing distance, closest separation, average estimated speed, and response timing.
BLACK_01 reduced ground-plane separation from RED_03 during the manually verified marking sequence. The follow-up median separation remained lower than the pre-command separation.
RED_03 moved toward the manually verified right-goal-side zone, entered it after the instruction sequence, and remained inside during the evaluated retention window.
Player identity and coach-instruction target were manually verified for this capability demonstration. Automated persistent identity and automated target attribution are evaluated separately.

Metre-based movement values are approximate ground-plane estimates derived from physically measured pitch dimensions and a validated planar homography. Independent landmark validation produced an RMSE of 0.651 m.
Automated persistent identity did not meet its reliability gate, so full-session player-level assessment remains withheld.
Review pressing timing and body position during the two demonstrated close-down events.
